summary: First-iteration backend testing for Italian food-recognition NutriSnap app. All 22 checks passed across 8 endpoints including profile computation (BMI/Mifflin-St Jeor), meal CRUD, daily summary, and Gemini 3 Flash food image analysis via Emergent LLM Key.
passed: POST /api/profile computes BMI=24.5 (normopeso) and daily_calorie_goal=2133 for male 175cm/75kg/30y/moderato/dimagrire (Mifflin-St Jeor + 1.55 factor - 500 kcal)
Profile returns all macro goals (protein=160, carbs=213, fat=71, fiber=30)
GET /api/profile/{device_id} returns null (200) when device not found
POST /api/analyze-food with real JPEG (Unsplash food photo) returned dish_name='Pizza con pollo BBQ e ananas', total_calories=1040 via gemini-3-flash-preview
POST /api/meals creates meal with generated id
GET /api/daily-summary returns correct totals (350 kcal, 1 meal) and goals from profile
DELETE /api/meals/{id} removes meal and returns 404 for non-existent id
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY loaded correctly and gemini-3-flash-preview integration working
